newsitem.title: NORWAY: Options fuel volume on Oslo Bourse.
newsitem.headline: Options fuel volume on Oslo Bourse.

text.p: Options exercised helped inflate volume on the Norwegian Stock Exchange on Friday and the Total index ended marginally higher.
Oslo's Total index closed 0.29 percent up at 1,177.79 points in turnover of 1.4 billion crowns.
"Apart from options exercised turnover was low," one broker said.
Anglo-Norwegian construction and engineering group Kvaerner and industrial conglomerate Norsk Hydro were by far the most traded shares.
Kvaerner's A share closed 0.83 percent higher at 427 crowns in trade worth 158 million crowns.
Norsk Hydro, the largest company listed on the bourse, climbed 1.29 percent to 392 crowns in turnover of 143 million crowns.
